input.question: Among the Commander-leadable cards that the Card Kingdom catalog lists for both a foil printing and a regular non-foil printing – cards listed for only one of the two printings don't count – I want the single most recent card frame year (the latest calendar year among the frame versions), and the count of cards in that group whose frame version is that year. Please return just that one row: the frame year and its card count.
input.evidence: A card 'may lead a Commander deck' if it can be the deck's commander – the one card that leads the deck and sets its color identity – not merely be included among the deck's other cards.

       COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(cardKingdomFoilId) AS foil_ids, COUNT(cardKingdomId) AS regular_ids,

FROM main.cards
GROUP BY leadershipSkills

arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM main.cards
WHERE INSTR(leadershipSkills, '''commander'': True') > 0
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
GROUP BY frame_year
ORDER BY frame_year DESC
LIMIT 1
